text:
Riley J.: quick update 1: were clarifying the midweek release freeze language after a few ambiguous asks this morning. please read and ack if you have scheduled rollouts touching serving, routing, or infra.
Nora H.: thanks. what exactly is in-scope for the freeze?
Riley J.: scope: any change that alters the serving binary, routing tables, ingress rules, or downgrade/roll-forward automation. SDK-only client changes that are backwards-compatible are ok. Schema migrations that only add read-only indexes are allowed with review.
ops-bot: notice: midweek_freeze: effective 2026-12-08T00:00:00Z -> 2026-12-09T12:00:00Z. Non-exempt risky rollouts will be blocked by the scheduler.
Jason K.: can we have a clear exemption path? some hotfixes may need fast-tracking.
Riley J.: yes 1: exemption path: file a freeze-exempt request in #eng-releases with: owner, urgency reason, mitigation steps, automated rollback plan, and expected runtime. Security/infra lead must +1 for approval. Review target: 90 minutes.
Nora H.: also: temporary canary caps during the freeze: max 4% traffic for safe canaries, 1% for experiments touching embeddings or reranking paths. Auto-pause on >1.0% error uplift for 5m, forced rollback at 10m.
release-svc: applied_policy: {"max_safe_canary_pct":"4","max_experiment_pct":"1","auto_pause_uplift_pct":"1.0","pause_window_mins":"5","forced_rollback_mins":"10"} (ops-enforced).
eng-oncall: rota update: padded oncall coverage for the freeze window 1: infra lead + runtime lead assigned each night. Please add pager info to your PRs.
Jason K.: paste a sample PR checklist we should use for fast reviews?
Riley J.: checklist (add as code block in PR): ```
- release.owner: @handle
- release.escalation_contact: pager #
- brief description + risk level
- rollback steps (sql/command + verification queries)
- smoke test name + expected metrics
- crowd-control plan (max traffic %)
```
Nora H.: Ops will also pin a short KB in #eng-notices and patch the release scheduler to enforce the caps.
Riley J.: final ask: if you have any running canaries or long experiments, reply here with name + current traffic % by EOD. Well compile a safe list and notify owners of required caps. :memo: 
Jason K.: ACK. I have "embed-v2-canary" at 2% 1 will cap to 0.8% during the freeze.
release-svc: scheduler_note: blocked 3 pending deployments that do not include required PR checklist metadata. Owners notified.
Riley J.: thanks all. Ill post the KB and pinned note in 30 minutes.
